scope: New responsiveness/render-speed DSP changes; startup and previous 74 implemented audit findings excluded.

parity.provenance: Independent esbuild bundles captured before editing this worktree at baseRevision; byte hashes compare produced Float32/Float64 PCM and complete spectrum JSON.

findings.title: Fuse Normalize DC sum and peak extrema in one PCM pass
findings.avoidedCost: Peak-enabled DC normalization no longer traverses the input separately for the sum and extrema.
findings.evidence: Iterator fixture reads fall from twelve to four after also replacing the mapper; only the separate measurement pass is counted here.
findings.limitations: Output indexed mapper repair is excluded from the count because prior audit #46 already counted that technique.

findings.title: Skip unused Normalize peak measurement for DC-only jobs
findings.avoidedCost: DC-only Normalize never needs extrema; the unified measurement loop omits those comparisons and extent arithmetic.
findings.evidence: DC-only source is visited once, and all DC-only baseline fixtures retain exact samples.
findings.limitations: Sum arithmetic and output rounding remain in their original order.

findings.title: Normalize the owned Legacy Compressor result in place
findings.avoidedCost: The follower output belongs to this invocation, so post-normalization can write it without allocating and retaining replacement channels.
findings.evidence: Float32 allocations fall from two to one for a normalized mono selection.
findings.limitations: Only internally owned result PCM is changed; caller input is preserved.

findings.title: Build Repeat by doubling the already-copied prefix
findings.avoidedCost: Native typed-array copy invocations scale logarithmically with repetition count rather than once per repeat.
findings.evidence: A 128-copy job uses eight set calls instead of 128, preserving signed-zero bytes.
findings.limitations: Output bytes are still necessarily proportional to the requested audio length.

findings.title: Calculate the medium-overdrive table logarithm once
findings.avoidedCost: Each medium-overdrive table entry shares the same logarithm and scale.
findings.evidence: Math.log calls fall from 1026 to two for one table, including the decibel conversion.
findings.limitations: The changing exponential numerator is retained for every entry.

findings.title: Calculate the hard-overdrive table denominator once
findings.avoidedCost: The denominator logarithm is invariant across every hard-overdrive table entry.
findings.evidence: Math.log calls fall from 2050 to 1026.
findings.limitations: Numerator logarithms and zero-parameter branch retain their prior arithmetic.

findings.title: Calculate the even-harmonics table normalization once
findings.avoidedCost: One shape normalization replaces a repeated invariant tanh and division in this separate waveshaper mode.
findings.evidence: Math.tanh calls fall from 4098 to 2050.
findings.limitations: Every changing tanh numerator is still calculated.

findings.title: Prepare the chosen Distortion sample shaper before PCM
findings.avoidedCost: The hard-clipping input-gain branch and gain construction leave the per-sample path in both live and selection processing.
findings.evidence: Source structure selects one shaper per configuration; 66 before-change distortion PCM hashes remain exact.
findings.limitations: This is one shared shaper optimization, counted once across its two hosts.

findings.title: Prepare the chosen Distortion output mixer before PCM
findings.avoidedCost: The eleven-mode output switch and fixed gain combinations leave the per-sample output-mixing path.
findings.evidence: Source structure selects one mixer per configuration; all live/offline and DC/mix update hashes remain exact.
findings.limitations: Output Float32 rounding is retained at the original point.

findings.title: Retain live Distortion tables on DC or mix updates
findings.avoidedCost: An update that changes output mix or DC blocking does not alter waveshaper geometry and no longer rebuilds 2049 entries.
findings.evidence: Medium-overdrive DC/mix update exponentials fall from 1026 to zero; shape update still redesigns the table.
findings.limitations: Even-harmonics parameter2 is part of the shape key; reset and update behavior remain owned by the existing LiveProcessor lifecycle.

findings.title: Retain the fixed Phaser LFO normalization
findings.avoidedCost: The fixed expm1(4) denominator is shared by offline and realtime phaser modulation rather than reevaluated at each LFO update.
findings.evidence: A 1024-frame offline plus realtime fixture reduces fixed-denominator calls from 104 to zero after module initialization.
findings.limitations: Counted once across both adaptations; no phase or smoothing order changes.

findings.title: Advance live Echo history with a bounded wrap
findings.avoidedCost: The Echo history pointer advances by one and wraps only at its known length, removing remainder operations from every sample.
findings.evidence: Exact partitioned Echo hashes cover delay wraparound and multi-channel history.
findings.limitations: The offline Echo already used bounded wrap and is excluded.

findings.title: Advance the Distortion DC-block ring with a bounded wrap
findings.avoidedCost: The rolling DC average pointer advances by one, so a length comparison replaces every remainder operation.
findings.evidence: All eleven modes with DC enabled retain exact offline/live Float32 fixtures.
findings.limitations: Only pointer arithmetic changes; rolling sum order is identical.

findings.title: Advance Reverb delay lines with bounded wraps
findings.avoidedCost: The pre-delay, comb and all-pass ring pointers all advance by one; each avoids remainder in the wet DSP path.
findings.evidence: Mono/stereo/three-channel 12031-frame hashes exercise wraps and tails with unchanged rounding.
findings.limitations: One Reverb ring-advance optimization is counted, not a separate label for each delay class.

findings.title: Skip standard-filter design on normalized identical updates
findings.avoidedCost: Live gesture/control repetitions retain current coefficients and double-precision history when all admitted effective parameters are identical.
findings.evidence: Repeated equivalent string/number controls produce zero coefficient cosine calls; changed controls still redesign.
findings.limitations: Full parameter validation still precedes the comparison; topology changes retain the original state replacement.

findings.title: Reuse the angular cosine while designing vocoder biquads
findings.avoidedCost: Each low-pass envelope biquad previously called the same cosine separately for numerator and denominator coefficients.
findings.evidence: A twelve-band bank decreases Math.cos calls from 192 to 144; mono/stereo/surround PCM hashes remain exact.
findings.limitations: This reduces live bank reconfiguration work, not the per-frame filter recurrence.

findings.title: Skip nonlinear gain math for neutral band compression
findings.avoidedCost: Ratio-one or zero-maximum compression continues updating detector energy while avoiding logarithm, knee and exponentiation for known unity gain.
findings.evidence: 2048 neutral gain calls produce zero logarithms; enabling compression still sees the retained detector history.
findings.limitations: The fast path requires finite accumulated energy, preserving pathological public inputs through the original equations.

findings.title: Skip crossover redesign for an unchanged target
findings.avoidedCost: Repeating the same crossover target does not need another tangent/design call and does not interrupt coefficient smoothing.
findings.evidence: An unchanged in-progress target causes zero tangent calls; NaN still throws.
findings.limitations: Object.is preserves signed-zero distinctions and changed targets keep existing smoothing.

findings.title: Skip Reverb redesign for an unchanged configuration
findings.avoidedCost: Identical normalized controls reuse existing gain/tone/tail geometry rather than solving the reverb release bound and rebuilding tone coefficients.
findings.evidence: An identical room-size update causes zero exponentials instead of fifty; changed tone still redesigns.
findings.limitations: A private configured-value snapshot also fences direct external mutation of the public params object.

findings.title: Select the Tone and Chirp oscillator before visiting PCM
findings.avoidedCost: The immutable waveform choice no longer requires square/sawtooth string dispatch for each generated frame.
findings.evidence: Twelve separate tone/chirp waveform and interpolation fixtures plus existing stateful hashes retain exact PCM.
findings.limitations: This shared oscillator preparation is counted once across tone and chirp; indirect call/JIT effects are workload-dependent.

findings.title: Advance generator phase with a bounded wrap
findings.avoidedCost: Admitted oscillator increments are at most half a cycle, so each positive phase needs at most one subtraction instead of remainder.
findings.evidence: Tone/Chirp exact hashes include near-Nyquist frequency and arbitrary block boundaries.
findings.limitations: Only admitted positive bounded phase accumulators use the fast wrap; floating operation order is preserved.

findings.title: Prepare the chosen Chirp interpolation once
findings.avoidedCost: The interpolation string branch and invariant frequency difference/ratio leave the per-frame sweep loop.
findings.evidence: Linear/logarithmic waveform fixtures preserve exact samples and phase partitions.
findings.limitations: Logarithmic exponentiation remains dominant; isolated logarithmic trials show no wall-time benefit.

findings.title: Skip raised-cosine evaluation inside flat Morse keying
findings.avoidedCost: The plateau has an exact unity raised-cosine envelope and does not need another cosine for every keyed sample.
findings.evidence: One 480-frame dot drops cosine calls from 480 to 78 edge calls.
findings.limitations: Ramp edge calculations and multiplication order remain unchanged.

findings.title: Select Noise color outside the frame loop
findings.avoidedCost: White, brown and pink states use separate bounded frame loops; color tests occur once per block/channel instead of for every random draw.
findings.evidence: Seeded three-channel color fixtures and existing 32-channel jump fixtures retain exact channel-major RNG and PCM.
findings.limitations: White-noise timing is effectively unchanged in warmed Node trials; pink improves. The deterministic improvement is avoided source dispatch.

findings.title: Retain bounded private spectrum Hann windows
findings.avoidedCost: Repeated spectral gestures/report computation at an accepted FFT size reuse its immutable Hann coefficients.
findings.evidence: The second 64-point report has six FFT-root cosine calls instead of seventy total cosine calls.
findings.limitations: The twelve accepted geometries use less than one MiB; caller report objects stay fresh and private coefficients are never exposed.

findings.title: Retain PFFFT plan heap views across transforms
findings.avoidedCost: Warm plans reuse input/output typed-array views instead of allocating two wrapper objects per FFT.
findings.evidence: Ten warm transforms allocate zero heap views instead of twenty; a large-plan heap-growth fixture refreshes old views safely.
findings.limitations: A changed WASM heap buffer invalidates both views, including after transform execution; runtime bytes are unchanged.

findings.title: Interpolate linear chunks without full concatenation copies
findings.avoidedCost: Only the retained interpolation boundary uses carry PCM; the remainder indexes borrowed current-chunk samples directly.
findings.evidence: Two 1024-frame chunks avoid both large combined-input allocations; sixteen rate/partition hashes remain exact.
findings.limitations: Retained history is still copied before returning, so mutating caller chunks cannot change future output.

findings.title: Trim owned linear output through a view
findings.avoidedCost: Returning the written prefix of an already-owned output allocation avoids a second full PCM copy for every chunk.
findings.evidence: A stereo 1024-frame chunk avoids copying 1880 output frames; output never aliases caller input.
findings.limitations: Each output owns its backing allocation but its buffer may include the small capacity slack; transferred buffers remain independent.

findings.title: Read ordinary integer delay taps without interpolation
findings.avoidedCost: Every admitted tap/compensation is an integer frame offset; nonzero finite ring samples need one read rather than floor/fraction/neighbor arithmetic.
findings.evidence: A stereo three-tap 1024-frame fixture eliminates 8192 interpolation floors. Nine exact delay fixtures include mix zero and signed zeros.
findings.limitations: The original zero-fraction expression is retained for zero samples to preserve signed-zero output.

findings.title: Share delay read positions across channels
findings.avoidedCost: Each frame computes one tap position per echo and one dry position, replacing duplicate channel-wise offset/compensation/modulo work.
findings.evidence: For the stereo three-tap fixture, source-confirmed position calculations drop from eight to four per frame; multichannel and StaffPad compensation suites pass.
findings.limitations: Ring growth and parameter updates rebuild offset geometry before processing; bounded write-index wrap is supporting code and not an extra count.

isolatedMeasurements.context: Node26.5 isolated kernel wall times, warmed alternating pairs; no Electron/app claim
